elham-farajnejad-business-name-fit-busin.description: Suggest, pick, or vet a business, startup, or product name that stays true to the founder's cultural origin while working professionally in the markets they want to sell into. Use whenever someone is naming a company, brand, or product and cares about how it lands across languages and regions — for example a name that sounds right at home but might read oddly to English speakers, or an authentic name they want to check before committing. Trigger this for any request about choosing a business name, checking if a name "works" abroad, spotting bad meanings in other languages, or making a name…
